provenance: Ten individually painted inventory cape illustrations generated with built-in imagegen from the current cape colors and emblems. Generated alpha is preserved through Lanczos resizing and composited over the standard dark teal inventory backing.
camera: nearly straight back view, isolated unworn cape
promptPrefix:
Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: Rabbit Lands inventory item icon, one isolated wearable cape.
Reference images 1 and 2 are STYLE ONLY: match the existing small painted equipment icons, broad matte cloth folds, warm restrained highlights, clear weighty fantasy silhouette, detailed enough to feel hand-painted but clean when reduced to 50x50 pixels. Reference image 3 is DESIGN ONLY: a lineup of the ten actual game capes; preserve the specified cape's palette and embroidered symbol.
Paint ONE unworn cape only, with its entire BACK face clearly visible, suspended naturally, no wearer or mannequin. Slight volume and broad pleats, the simple round shoulder yoke at the top and gently flared hem at the bottom. View almost straight on from the back so the emblem stays readable. Center it, occupying about 85% of a square canvas with safe empty margin. Emblem is embroidered into the cloth, large, clear, flat in broad folds. The cape is the only subject.
Transparent background with real alpha. No scene, pedestal, cast shadow, frame, tile border, labels, text, numbers, hands, person, hood, extra items, sparkles, dramatic glow, glossy plastic or extra logos.
